qbbghPuRGt8.title: Born Between 11 p.m. and 12:30 a.m.? Why Saju apps may disagree
qbbghPuRGt8.description:
Were you born between 11 p.m. and 12:30 a.m.?

Here's the third reason from our December 11 channel post, "Why Saju apps give different results," laid out as a timeline. 11 p.m. is when the hour of 子 Midnight Water (Jasu) begins by the clock; 11:30 p.m. is when it begins by the sun, because Korean clocks run about 30 minutes ahead of the actual sun. 12:30 a.m. is midnight by the sun, and the hour ends at 1:30 a.m.

If you were born between 11 p.m. and 12:30 a.m., the date can differ by one day from one Saju calendar to another, depending on whether it adjusts for longitude and whether it turns the day when this hour begins or at midnight. When the date changes, the Day Master character changes too. The GOYO app adjusts for longitude and counts from 11:30 p.m. as the next day. If another calendar gives you a different Day Master, this hour may be the reason. It's fine to read the Day Masters of both days.

Where you were born matters as well. Solar time shifts by 4 minutes for every degree of longitude, so the gap is about 34 minutes in Mokpo, about 32 in Seoul and about 24 in Busan. The GOYO app adjusts based on Seoul. And if you were born between March 21, 1954 and August 9, 1961, Korean clocks then ran on 127.5°E and were already almost in step with the sun, so the 30 minutes aren't subtracted (daylight saving periods need to be checked separately).

vqDQ9BPFJZA.title: 辛金 Yin Metal (Singeum) Day Master in 2027: born in summer or winter?

A 辛金 Yin Metal (Singeum) Day Master: were you born in summer, or in winter?

Yin Metal is Metal (Stone & Ore) that shines soft and clear. The old Saju classic Di Tian Sui (滴天髓) says of it: "熱則喜母 寒則喜丁" — in heat it welcomes its mother; in cold it welcomes 丁. Born in summer, it is said to welcome the earth that eases the heat, 己土 Yin Earth (Gito); born in winter, the lamp that melts the cold, 丁火 Yin Fire (Jeonghwa). Your birth month follows the solar terms.

In its characters, the coming 丁未 year (Jeongmi) · Yin Fire · Afternoon Earth holds both: Yin Fire (丁), and the Yin Earth (己) inside 未 Afternoon Earth (Mito). But Afternoon Earth is the dry earth at the end of high summer, so how it lands depends on the whole chart. And for Yin Metal, Yin Fire is a welcome fire that can also feel a little heavy. So this year may be one where something a little hard to carry ends up shaping you into something sturdier.

In Saju, the year turns at the start of spring (立春): February 4, 2027, 10:46 a.m. KST.

yeAxjSAy01A.title: Sungnyemun's 禮: why Seoul's South Gate carries the virtue of Fire
yeAxjSAy01A.description:
Namdaemun's real name is Sungnyemun (崇禮門). Why "禮," courtesy, of all things?

People of old paired the five elements with five virtues: Wood with benevolence (仁), Fire with courtesy (禮), Earth with trust (信), Metal with righteousness (義), Water with wisdom (智). The gates of old Seoul's city wall follow these pairs: Heunginjimun (仁) in the east, Donuimun (義) in the west, Sungnyemun (禮) in the south, and at the very center Bosingak (信), named in King Gojong's time.

The south is the place of Fire. Unlike the other gates, Sungnyemun's name board hangs vertically; the Jibong Yuseol (芝峰類說) records the story that this was meant to hold back the fire energy of Gwanaksan Mountain to the south. A pond called Namji (南池) once lay in front of the gate, water for fighting fires and also meant to press down the mountain's fire energy. It was filled in in 1910.

2027 is a Fire year: the 丁未 year (Jeongmi) · Yin Fire · Afternoon Earth. Fire's virtue was seen as courtesy (禮). In Saju, the year turns at the start of spring (立春) on February 4.

mvl0ZpysLeU.title: Find Your Day Master in 3 Seconds
mvl0ZpysLeU.description:
How to find your Day Master in 3 seconds.

Enter your birth date and hour into a Saju calendar or app, and four pillars appear. Traditional charts are written right to left: year, month, day, hour. The order can differ from app to app, so look for the pillar marked "day" (日). The top character of that day pillar is your Day Master, the one of the eight characters in your chart that stands for you.

There are ten Day Masters, from 甲木 Yang Wood (Gapmok) to 癸水 Yin Water (Gyesu). GOYO has a playlist for each, so you can start with the one for yours. You'll get your Day Master even without knowing your birth hour. But if you were born between 11 p.m. and 12:30 a.m., your Day Master may differ from one Saju calendar to another (see the January 8 short).

Tonight's sound is "First Frost" from 「다섯 가지 고요」 (Five Kinds of Quiet), the Metal (Stone & Ore) episode. The free app for finding your Day Master and the music are in the links below.
